messages:
emma: noticed sample-app (node) triggers duplicate streaming starts when token refresh hits a 429 mid-stream. repro in staging.

kai: logs? sounds like client issues a fresh Start instead of resuming.

emma: yes - two StartStream 200ms apart, different stream ids, identical payload.

lena: which SDK version? node or python?

emma: node v1.8.2. python not reproing. sample-app sets X-Request-ID but no idempotency key.

oscar: quick mitigation: add randomized jitter on retry after refresh and send an Idempotency-Key on Start. server can dedupe within a short window.

kai: agree. recommend client jitter: base 100-300ms randomized, expo capped ~2s. server dedupe TTL ~10s to cover GC/latency.

lena: SDK change: default to attach Idempotency-Key for Start calls; include resume_token only when resuming. document clearly.

emma: i'll add idempotency + jitter to sample-app and run stress test, open PR.

build-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-01T02:00Z on cluster-01.

oscar: follow-ups: (1) Emma PR to sample-app, (2) Runtime: prototype 10s dedupe cache + metrics, (3) SDK: add jitter + default idempotency in next minor.

emma: PR created (draft) with repro script and notes. will update onboarding docs to recommend Idempotency-Key for streams.
